description: All event-role memberships of this word occurrence, retaining correlated event_id, role and scope_id when one mention participates in several predicates.
reason: The catalog's singular event_id/role cannot retain multiple event memberships. This differs from event_role_conflict, which diagnoses incompatible roles.

description: Entity-bound perceived surface color, explicitly distinguished from material composition; assertion_status records evidence attribution, while factuality preserves negated or proposed color.
reason: The catalog has material_composition but no typed color dimension; legacy attributes can store color only as an unbound string.

description: A text-supported metaphor or simile linking a target referent to a source image without asserting source-domain events or identity.
reason: irony_interpretation requires communicative irony; lexical_idiom_reading requires a conventional idiom; neither covers the novel cake-decoration metaphors or candle/twig simile.

description: Bound part entity, whole entity and physical or represented-world scope.
reason: Lexical part types do not establish token-level actual part ownership; bridging_relation is reference licensing rather than the actual relation.
